acceptanceCriteria: A Corvint command binds a Playwright JSON report (report digest, run identity, project) into BehaviorRun/receipt inputs that behavior-adapter accepts, so a clean run counts toward runtime_witnessed_contracts.
Missing, failed, retried-flaky or foreign-project results stay unwitnessed with a named reason, never credited.
body: Tests carry runtime {evidence, observation} that must resolve to a BehaviorRun plus a qualified receipt, but there is no importer from a Playwright JSON report or per-run manifest, so runtime_witnessed_contracts stays 0 even for suites that ran clean. Source: beamfall/corvint#717.
title: docs corpus: import a Playwright JSON report or run manifest as a BehaviorRun runtime witness
